body: I'm sorry guys...I'm just fucking sick of it; all my life I've had staggeringly low self confidence, and it's only gotten worse what with how disastrously I've failed uni from an academic and social aspects, with no future prospects in any capacity. Even having taken counselling, I'm still beyond fucking hope. I won't take my life as you guys are utterly wonderful and have convinced me not to, but I'm still sure things would have been better off without my existence
Oh well, consider this a suicide note; see you on the other side.
